# Shipday

Making Local Deliveries Easy Globally - Powering Local E-commerce

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/shipday/.

## Actions

- **Add a Carrier**: Add a new carrier/driver to the Shipday system with credentials.
- **Check On-Demand Delivery Availability** (read-only): Check on-demand delivery availability from third-party service providers.
- **Edit Delivery Order**: Edit an existing delivery order in Shipday.
- **Get On-Demand Delivery Estimate** (read-only): Get on-demand delivery estimates from third-party service providers for a specific order.
- **Insert Order**: Create a new delivery order in Shipday.
- **Orders Query** (read-only): Query delivery orders with filters and pagination.
- **Query Delivery Orders** (read-only): Query delivery orders with time-based filters and cursor pagination.
- **Retrieve Active Orders** (read-only): Retrieve all active delivery orders from Shipday system.
- **Retrieve Carriers** (read-only): Retrieve all carriers/drivers with profile and status details.
- **Retrieve Order Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information for a specific delivery order by order number.
- **Get On-Demand Delivery Services** (read-only): Retrieve available third-party on-demand delivery service providers.
- **Order Ready to Pickup**: Mark a delivery order as ready for pickup.
- **Unassign Order from Driver**: Remove driver assignment from a delivery order.
